scope: Pinned source cache body and full 54-block trajectory on two real Echo segments versus native, using compact chunked MPS attention and BF16 checkpoint weights expanded to F32. Independent 60-latent native decoder replay. This is not Magi/CUDA parity or a perceptual fix.
reason: The reported eye and motion defects survive the text-cache correction and change little in source-BF16 arithmetic. Distinguish a native continuation error from a model/conditioning or decoder issue.

refuted_route.hypothesis: Padded source-MPS arithmetic mismatch localizes a native five-second continuation bug.
refuted_route.falsifier: Segment 0 already differs before any cache history, while native segment 0 equals its previous single-segment source control. Removing only 19 false K/V padding rows restores all60 values exactly.
refuted_route.pivot: Match allowed-key reduction geometry before attributing trajectory differences to native cache composition.

native_decoder_replay.scope: The new opt-in standalone decoder path equals the saved native ten-second display output. It does not add upstream quality evidence.

verification.cpu_signal: 17 tests pass: pinned no-cache, writer and reader bodies in both layouts; masked/compact numerical negative control; default remains padded.
verification.runtime_command: Frozen exact argv in launch.json, externally guarded and run serially.
verification.runtime_signal: Both segments and prior segment-0 control are bitexact; guard and source pins unchanged.

limitations: The adapter preserves source cache construction and masking but replaces CUDA Magi dispatch with chunked MPS SDPA.
Matching native/source final latents does not prove visual quality, nor equivalence of every intermediate operation.
The compact layout is diagnostic and opt-in; the production generator and precision defaults are unchanged.
Compact K/V concatenation creates temporary GPU buffers; its planned cap is metadata and requires the external process/OS guard.
The user reports source BF16 eyes are only slightly better, with the same main defect.
Background optical-flow slowdown is correlated with five-second boundaries; no causal fix has been demonstrated.

refresh.operation: Authenticate inputs and current pins, rerun both layouts plus prior segment0 control under fresh memory admission, then reassess visual quality separately.
refresh.failure_policy: Reopen the scoped continuation claim; retain the known production path.

adversary.lineage: same-lineage review, correlated; separate artifact rehash and byte comparison
adversary.verdict: ROBUST for bounded native/source-MPS final-latent agreement and native standalone decode replay; VULNERABLE for CUDA/Magi or visual-quality claims
adversary.checks: Rehashed source/input bindings and compared actual payload bytes, prior segment0, NCTHW extraction, row counts, and sampled guard limits. comparison-v2 adds explicit baseline artifact bindings and row inventory omitted from the initial report.
